text:
molly: Heads-up: release train for v0.12.3 — cutoff in 8h (16:00 UTC). Please flag any PRs that absolutely need to get in. We'll be cutting release-branch at 16:05 UTC. :alarm_clock:

sam: Quick Q — are we bumping minor or patch? There are a couple of API-surface tweaks in #4329.

molly: patch. We agreed on v0.12.3 at planning. #4329 should be backwards-compatible. If it touches client API, call it out now.

vivian: Docs here — I have a changelog fragment ready, will paste below. Will need a docs-owner +1 before I merge.

vivian: ```
- v0.12.3: Improve batching heuristics to reduce tail latency (service-team)
- Fix: session KV cache occasional eviction during long chat sessions
- Docs: clarify model-pin behavior for private deployments
```

alex: QA ETA ~= 13:30 UTC. I'll run the regression matrix against canary and post results. If anything flakey, we'll push to tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary windows scheduled: staging canary 14:00-15:00 UTC, production canary 15:15-15:45 UTC. Auto-roll back threshold: error_rate > 3% or latency_p95 > 2x baseline.

jordan: Note: new batching flag `enable_smart_batching` is off in prod. We should keep it gated for this release. Ops already added the feature flag for the release branch.

sam: ping @vivian on #4329 for a quick review, it's blocking the version bump commit.

vivian: on it, looking now. should be done in ~10m. :eyes: 

molly: Also drafting announce copy for #announcements. Please approve short blurb:

molly: "Release v0.12.3: performance and reliability fixes, improved batching. Rolling out next hour. Read the full changelog in the release notes. :rocket:"

sam: LGTM for announce.

alex: If QA passes I'll set the release tag and trigger the release workflow:
```
git checkout release-branch
git merge --no-ff main
git tag -a v0.12.3 -m "release v0.12.3"
git push origin release-branch v0.12.3
```

molly: One more reminder — if your PR hasn't got a changelog blurb, add one now. We'll block merges without changelog entries for this cycle.

vivian: changelog entry added and PR merged. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Release pipeline triggered by tag v0.12.3. Status: pending canary.

alex: Canary looks clean so far. No regressions on core tests. Proceeding to prod canary in 5.

molly: Thanks team. If we need to slip, call it in the next 20m. Otherwise I'll post to #announcements at 15:50 UTC. :thumbsup:
